Proxy._comment: ClientIpHeader = the request header the edge in front of the portal sets to the visitor's IP (Render sits behind Cloudflare, which sets CF-Connecting-IP and overwrites any value a client sends). Sign-in throttling keys on it; empty = the connection's address (the last proxy hop on Render, which changes per request). Only set it where every request passes that edge.

MainApp._comment: Match the main Omni app. PublicBaseUrl = its public HTTPS origin (no trailing slash). Billing pages call the main app's platform-admin API: ApiBaseUrl = where to call it (blank = PublicBaseUrl); PlatformAdminApiKey is a SECRET equal to the main app's PlatformAdmin:ApiKey — set it via the MainApp__PlatformAdminApiKey env var or user-secrets, never here.
